facts.fact: Law 008/2022 of 15 June 2022 makes the Centre National de l'Etat Civil the public service that implements government civil registration policy, builds the digital, biometric and centralised civil register and directs the civil status centres, its organisation to be fixed by decree on the proposal of the minister in charge of the Interior; the law gives no budget line.
facts.system: Registre numérique, biométrique et centralisé de l'état civil (Centre National de l'Etat Civil)

systems.system: Registre numérique, biométrique et centralisé de l'état civil
systems.country_label: registre numérique, biométrique et centralisé de l'état civil; Centre National de l'Etat Civil (CNEC)
systems.owner: Centre National de l'Etat Civil, under the minister in charge of the Interior
systems.tiers: as designed in law, not as deployed: at least one civil status centre in every department, district, commune and arrondissement and in each diplomatic or consular post (art. 16), each to receive declarations, enrol civil and biometric data, draw up acts and enter them in the register, and transmit the data to the CNEC (art. 17); a provincial service in each province running a provincial server with a secured connection to the CNEC (arts. 18-19). Events: births, deaths, marriages, divorces and others (art. 5).

systems.system: Information from the civil register to other state services
systems.tiers: art. 14: the CNEC is to supply information and services drawn from the civil register to other state services that ask

note: The law states a legal design, not a deployment: the centres' effective establishment is left to a regulatory act (art. 16), transmission and organisation to regulation (arts. 15, 20, 21), and until the CNEC, the provincial services and the centres are effectively in place the existing officers continue (art. 34). No events, made or offices fact is recorded, since the law does not say any office registers digitally.
